reason: Both unplug first and both eventually respect her refusal to unscrew the filter, but Conversation 2 lands on the expected resolution: filter almost certainly blocked, have 'someone handy' do it once the tube has drained the drum, or book an engineer (noting warranty), plus leaving a wall gap so the hose isn't crushed again and not running full washes meanwhile. Conversation 1 does the nice pump-hum check and correctly rejects a dead pump, but then jumps straight to 'call an engineer' to open the pump housing without offering the simpler alternative of another person cleaning the filter. Conversation 2 is also more efficient (hose, sink and retry covered in one turn) and gives better controlled-draining tips, though it is marked down slightly for suggesting she scoop water out of the main door, which would be locked with water in the drum.
